g.aria-label: Plots central curve mean(x) with translucent
Validates invariant: lo ≤ mean ≤ hi everywhere
(raises ValueError on inverted bounds; NaNs ok)
in linear OR logarithmic axis coordinates!
Multiple estimators sit side-by-side at each x
Auto-rotates categorical x-tick labels by 30° whenever len(x) > 3 to prevent text collisions.
Used across the Probability, Evaluation, and Bandit chapters to report estimates with error bars.
